title: THE DIPLOMA STILL HAS TO BE EARNED
concept: A characterized diploma press refuses an AI auto-stamp, then carries one sheet through classroom judgment, consequential-decision oversight, and a clock that cannot start while the framework remains a draft.

treatment.logline: UA's draft makes one trust promise in two places: AI may assist, but competence must still be earned and consequential AI must remain meaningfully overseen by people.
treatment.cold_open: An AI handle drops toward a blank UA diploma and brakes one millimeter above the paper as WHO EARNED IT snaps into frame.
treatment.escalation: The diploma collects practice, passes three faculty-controlled campus rooms, and rides shared system support before flipping into a consequential-decision file.
treatment.turn: Meaningful and earned sound strong but are not measurements, so the proposal itself must face an evidence gate.
treatment.button: The machine steadies the sheet. A human pulls the press.
treatment.judge_reasoning: The Explainer treatment won for making the classroom and decision-desk promises one causal story. The Comedian's refused auto-stamp, draft clip, and clock gag were grafted in. The Dramatist's seal and hard-word counterpoint strengthened Act 3. The Enthusiast lens contributed the bright shared-support rail without turning the proposal into a sales pitch.

fingerprint.palette: parchment oxblood brass marigold with mint utility accents
fingerprint.metaphor: a diploma press that refuses automation until human judgment can close it

palette: Warm parchment is the world, oxblood marks institutional promises, marigold separates campus judgment, brass belongs to earned human action, and mint appears only on active AI assistance.

hook.frame1: A dimensional brass press races toward a parchment diploma while a green machine hand reaches for the handle and the seal remains visibly blank.
hook.headline: WHO EARNED IT?
hook.loopback: The final human pull lands the same press the opening machine could not close, and the stamped sheet slides back into the opening position.

open_loop.what: Who gets to close the press? The final human pull answers the opening question.

open_loop_2.what: When does the twelve-month clock begin? It stays frozen until IF ADOPTED is shown.

throughline.object: the brass WHO EARNED THIS question token

states.state: ejected by the automatic press as a scalloped brass WHO EARNED THIS question seal
rides the diploma and locks into the center axle between three faculty-controlled rooms
stays face-on through the paper flip and snaps into the oversight gate as its engraved escutcheon
rotates off the opened gate and onto the evidence-ledger spine at the Act 3 boundary
stretches into the IF ADOPTED key while preserving its scalloped edge and engraving
rolls out of the conditional track toward the evidence map at the Act 4 boundary
travels along the physical divider between the OVERSIGHT ledger and separate CREDENTIAL lane
returns to the credential press and rotates from WHO EARNED THIS into the EARNED seal over completed student work

throughline.lands_in_button: The same brass question token becomes the EARNED credential seal; it never becomes a claim that a human must make every consequential final decision.

reveals.what: The single diploma pullback reveals three separate campus rooms and one shared support rail.
The diploma begins its edge-on perspective flip at 45.1 seconds; the coherent transformation lands when four consequential-use tabs burst at 53.1 seconds.
The frozen clock chamber opens only to an IF ADOPTED key, revealing the conditional one-year work.

audio_arc.note: Paper percussion and warm mallets build under the press. The bed narrows when meaningful and earned are questioned, then drops six decibels before the human pull and returns with one brass chord.

divergence_note: This is not September 1's flowing cosmic ribbon or August 30's technical field. It is a warm tactile institutional world built around one mechanical refusal, with paper transformations, three campus rooms, a human review desk, and a conditional clock chamber. The dominant motion changes from continuous signal travel to vertical press impacts and perspective paper flips. The register moves from spatial science schematic to collegiate collage, and the hero changes from an energy ribbon to a characterized credential press.
